/*getCategoryListSelectPop*/
SELECT SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12) AS CATEG_CODE, MAX((SELECT CATEG_NAME FROM ICOMBYCA WHERE COM_CODE = B.COM_CODE AND CATEG_SYS_CODE = SUBSTR(b.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12))) AS CATEG_NAME, NVL(SUM(DECODE(A.CART_QTY,0,1,A.CART_QTY) * C.UNIT_PRICE),0) AS TOT_AMT FROM ICOMCART A, ICOMBYCA B, ICOMCQDT C, ICOMBYIT D WHERE C.BUYER = #{byca_comorg_code} AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER AND C.BUYER = D.BUYER AND B.COM_CODE = C.BUYER AND B.STD_CATEG_ID = D.CATEGORY_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND C.BUYER_ITEM_NO = D.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND D.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND D.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.USER_ID = #{user_id} AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C' GROUP BY SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12) ORDER BY SUBSTR(B.CATEG_SYS_CODE,0,12)

/*getTermType*/
SELECT DISTINCT TERM AS CODE, SUBSTR(TERM,0,4)||DECODE(SUBSTR(TERM,5,2),'H1','년도 상반기','H2','년도 하반기' ,'Q1','년도 1/4분기','Q2','년도 2/4분기' ,'Q3','년도 3/4분기','Q4','년도 4/4분기' ,'01','년도 1월','02','년도 2월' ,'03','년도 3월','04','년도 4월' ,'05','년도 5월','06','년도 6월' ,'07','년도 7월','08','년도 8월' ,'09','년도 9월','10','년도 10월' ,'11','년도 11월','12','년도 12월' ,'년도') TEXT1 FROM ICOMBDGT WHERE BUYER =#{SessionComCode} AND DEPT = #{SessionUserDept} AND FROM_DATE LIKE SUBSTR(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'),0,4)||'%' ORDER BY TERM

/*getAccountTypeSelect*/
SELECT CODE AS CODE , TEXT2 AS TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE 1=1 AND COMPANY_CODE = #{SEARCH} -- 파라메터 고객사 코드 AND TYPE = 'Z014'

/*getBuyerAdminBudgetListSql*/
SELECT (SELECT C.TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.CODE = A.DEPT AND C.TYPE = 'C001') DEPT_NAME, --[0] (SELECT C.TEXT2 FROM ICOMCOD2 C WHERE C.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND C.CODE = A.ACCOUNT_TYPE AND C.TYPE = 'Z014') ACCOUNT_TYPE_NAME, --[1] DECODE(A.TERM_TYPE,'Y','년','H','반기','Q','분기','M','월','') TERM_TYPE, --[2] SUBSTR(A.TERM,0,4)||DECODE(SUBSTR(A.TERM,5,2),'H1','년도 상반기','H2','년도 하반기' ,'Q1','년도 1/4분기','Q2','년도 2/4분기' ,'Q3','년도 3/4분기','Q4','년도 4/4분기' ,'01','년도 1월','02','년도 2월' ,'03','년도 3월','04','년도 4월' ,'05','년도 5월','06','년도 6월' ,'07','년도 7월','08','년도 8월' ,'09','년도 9월','10','년도 10월' ,'11','년도 11월','12','년도 12월' ,'년도') TERM_TEXT, --[3] NVL(A.PLAN_AMT,'0') PLAN_AMT, --[4] NVL(A.RESULT_AMT,'0') RESULT_AMT, --[5] NVL(A.PLAN_AMT,'0') - (NVL(A.RESULT_AMT,'0')+ NVL(A.TEMP_AMT,'0')) MONEY, --[6] 잔액 A.REMARK , --[7] A.PLAN_DATE , --[8] A.LAST_RESULT_DATE, --[9] NVL(A.TEMP_AMT,'0') TEMP_AMT, --[10] A.TERM , --[11] A.FROM_DATE , --[12] A.TO_DATE , --[13] A.DEPT , --[14] A.ACCOUNT_TYPE , --[15] A.TERM_TYPE , --[16] 'CHANGE' CHECK_VALUE, --[17] A.DEPT ORG_DEPT_CODE, --[18] A.ACCOUNT_TYPE ORG_ACCOUNT_TYPE, --[19] A.TERM ORG_TERM, --[20] DECODE(NVL(A.REMARK ,'icon') , 'icon' ,'off.gif' ,'on.gif') REMARK_IMG --[21] FROM ICOMBDGT A, ICOMCOD3 B , ICOMCOD3 C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND B.CODE1 = #{change_user_dept} --세션값 AND B.CODE2 = A.DEPT AND B.TYPE = 'DTOD' AND A.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.DEPT = C.CODE1 AND A.ACCOUNT_TYPE = C.CODE2 AND C.TYPE = 'DTOA'
AND A.ACCOUNT_TYPE = #{st_account_type} --계정선택값
AND SUBSTR(TERM,0,4) = #{st_select_year} --년도 선택값 AND DECODE(C.FLAG,'Y',DECODE( #{change_user_dept} ,C.CODE1,'N','Y'),'N') = 'N'
AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN FROM_DATE AND TO_DATE
AND A.TERM = #{st_term_type}
ORDER BY DEPT_NAME , ACCOUNT_TYPE_NAME, TO_DATE DESC
